title: Duel Decks: Garruk vs. Liliana: card flavor text

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who enjoys the moment when roaring becomes squealing and demands obedience of the dead.

entities.name: Bulgo
entities.description: A man turned into a tree by Lignify, puzzled by his stiffness.

entities.name: Dionus
entities.description: An elvish archdruid who dislikes interlopers and thieves in the skies.

entities.name: Keren-Dur
entities.description: A necromancer lord who calls graveyards sacrilege and a waste of bones.

entities.name: Radavi
entities.description: A Joraga relic hunter whose last words boast that dark magic will not stop her.

entities.name: Xathrid demon
entities.description: A demon who accepts only one currency for his bargains.

entities.name: Wirewood
entities.description: An elvish forest whose child an elf has become.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest known only from the few who made it out alive.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara where death and decay abound and corpses are currency among necromancers and demons.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane to which a Phyrexian rager keeps the choicest bits.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A land of Dominaria where violent storms occur on cloudless days.

events.summary: Bulgo is turned to wood by Lignify, puzzled by the rustling and his stiffness.
Dionus declares elves dislike interlopers and thieves in their skies.
events.quote: We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies.

events.summary: Radavi, a Joraga relic hunter, speaks her last words dismissing dark magic.
events.quote: A little dark magic won't stop me.

events.summary: Liliana develops a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.
events.quote: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

events.summary: Liliana Vess declares death no excuse for disobedience.
events.quote: Death is no excuse for disobedience.
